definitions.gloss: stray dog; feral dog; wild dog
definitions.explanation: A dog living without an owner, roaming freely in the wild or in urban areas. Includes both abandoned domestic dogs and those born in the wild.

examples.japanese: ⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{野犬|やけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}かけた→見かける：01644_mikakeru⟧。
examples.english: I spotted a stray dog in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{野犬|やけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Stray dogs are increasing in this area.

examples.japanese: {野犬|やけん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{見|み}つけたら→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧{保健所|ほけんじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}して→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Approaching stray dogs is dangerous, so if you find one, please contact the public health center.

notes: Also sometimes read as ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いぬ, though やけん is the standard reading. Common collocations include {野犬|やけん}{狩|が}り (rounding up stray dogs) and {野犬|やけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{群|む}れ→群れ：00298_mure⟧ (a pack of stray dogs). Compare with ⟦{野良犬|のらいぬ}→野良犬：14464_norainu⟧ (stray dog, more colloquial) and ⟦{捨|す}て{犬|いぬ}→捨て犬：24573_suteinu⟧ (abandoned dog). In Japan, stray dogs are managed by {保健所|ほけんじょ} (public health centers) and {動物愛護|どうぶつあいご}⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧ (animal welfare centers).
